problemas.description: The initial screen does not clearly communicate the operation flow.
What does GIS mean? Will everyone understand?
The flag at the bottom is not well-aligned.
"Home Page" title - is it clickable? It has the same color scheme as the menu.
"Loading mapstore" - loading is in English while the system is in Portuguese.
Only mentions storing cookies without explaining what it means in the context where the user must agree.
The map does not contextualize the state of Santa Catarina with the others - could at least show the borders.
The button in the lower left corner to change the background does not clearly indicate that it is clickable.
The map outline option becomes illegible - difficult to read due to color contrast.
The "manual" icon for help is hard to find and unclear.
"No information available for this point" when clicking on an item outside the map - should not be considered clickable.
Tooltip with map point information presents acronyms difficult for the general population to understand.
In the layer list, there are several acronyms to select - what do they mean?
Layers - in the layer list - "Antas" has a subtle shift in relation to "SADPLAN" - hard to see that it is a sub-item.
What is "balanco_hidrico_antes"? No clear description provided.
"balanco_hidrico_antes" - what is it? The description only indicates "blue line" - does not satisfactorily explain.
Toggling the layer visibility - a term difficult for users to understand.
Line with percentage of line contrast - difficult to understand how it works.
Difficult to understand what the explaining balloon refers to - only by the lower arrow? (to which point on the map is this related?)
When deactivating municipal boundaries, the divisions still appear in the layer list.
Capture and classification layer - what is it? How to use?
The layer icon is a menu (hamburger), but does not act like a menu.
Menu icon shows "capture" and "grab..." - distinct descriptions for different functions for the same icon.
Searching for "São" - shows items up to Russia, but it’s only the state of SC.
Auto-complete items do not prioritize the context of Santa Catarina in the search.
Menu icon is used to offer choices of search types (coordinate or place name).
Searching by coordinates - lat / lon - non-descriptive names.
lat/lon in search by coordinates is outlined in red, as if it had already been filled in incorrectly before.
What do "degree gms/degree decimal" mean? In settings.
X icon to clear field - does not correspond to common use (amid other icons).
Search by incorrect latitude and longitude shows location "in the middle of nowhere," without feedback.
Even when logged in, clicking on the profile icon shows the option to "login," suggesting you are not logged in.
Login status does not appear to be working.
"Drop your map context" - translation does not make sense.
Mouse icon shows the option to hide/show layers (bottom right corner) - the icon does not make sense.
What is a query? It is not clear whether it is a public consultation or what it is for.
SIOUT Consultation - it is not clear that selecting an item affects the list of subsequent ones.
Search in the consultation is very slow.
When the search is stuck, there is no option to cancel.
The result does not indicate how many results were listed.
There is no explanation about the numbers or types of results - does not explain what the items in the results are.
When clicking on a result in the consultation list, it shows the point but does not leave a visual indication of which is currently selected.
When clicking on the item to show details, there is an overlay of balloons, and it is difficult to change.
Result point - detail balloon - X button as retract, not as close.
Result point - detail balloon - some items show with empty details.
When clearing the consultation, it removes the point, but the pop-up with details remains on the screen.
When exporting, it does not ask for confirmation, and immediately starts the automatic download of a .zip file.
When exporting, a read me in English says the result is empty.
When exporting, it does not explain that the data will come in shape files.
Does not give feedback on whether the export was successful or not.
Consulting objects on the map (local icon) only shows the map.
The upper right corner shows two menu (sandwich) icons very close together - what are they for?
